entities.summary: Álvaro Laureano Miguel Gómez Hurtado A.K.A. Álvaro Gómez Hurtado was a Colombian lawyer, politician, painter, writer, journalist and former active member of the Colombian Conservative Party. Gómez was founder of conservative dissidence known as Movimiento de Salvación Nacional, and their first presidente since 1990 to 1995, when he was murdered.
